headline: Clips that open on silence sync again
highlights: A clip that opens on room tone or silence before the first word syncs again — every placement was scored from the clip's first two seconds, so a quiet opening scored zero against the position that was exactly right
That same silence could also place a clip somewhere else entirely and still call it solved; those placements are right now
A clip exactly as long as the master now syncs, and one genuinely longer says which of the two reasons it was refused
